purpose: Focused behavioral regressions for specialist return and caller composition.

run_policy.actor: fresh session with current candidate skills loaded; receive only case prompt and fixture
run_policy.consumer: fresh session; for material cross-session cases receive the canonical Taskbook plus the delta-only handoff and unchanged fixture facts
run_policy.judge: score observed trajectory, canonical Taskbook, and handoff delta; do not reward contract self-description or duplicated plans
run_policy.claim: Loading or naming a Skill is not sufficient evidence of owner transfer

cases.prompt: 已确认的 Intent 是：A/B/C 在同一请求内共享只读公共解析，模型配置派生仍各自持有，请求协调层在所有模型结束后释放，不跨请求共享、不改变输出。现在只剩两个 bounded concrete ambiguity 会影响交接：A/B/C 获取共享结果的 usage/interface，以及模型完成、取消与 request cleanup 的 core-path 连接。请用最便宜的可检查 representation 分别关闭这两个局部问题，再由整体 Intent owner 把采用结果接回 canonical Taskbook；如果需要跨 session，只生成 delta-only handoff。不要把整个 Intent 委托给局部 specialist。
required: Northstar identifies bounded questions and invokes Beacon
each Beacon result is observable as a scoped return rather than only a Skill load or role claim
Northstar explicitly resumes, adopts or rejects the returned result, and performs overall composition
the trajectory does not claim an external agent or thread invocation without a corresponding real tool event
the canonical Taskbook preserves A/B/C, model-local derivation, request lifetime, no cross-request sharing, and unchanged output; the handoff only points to it plus resume delta
fail_if: the actor jumps from reading Beacon instructions directly to a complete final handoff
the actor fabricates a sub-agent or thread invocation, result, or failure
Beacon becomes the canonical Intent owner
the final response is only disconnected local artifacts
the session handoff duplicates the full adopted design instead of leaving durable semantics in the Taskbook
cases.consumer_check: A fresh worker reads the canonical Taskbook plus short handoff and can recover one adopted interface/lifecycle path and all binding constraints without reconstructing the Beacon results.

cases.prompt: 使用 Northstar 收敛当前工程 Intent：事实已经确认，当前 producer 和三个 consumers 都能生成 normalized data，现有实现由每个 consumer 重复生成；长期到底由 producer 还是 consumers 拥有仍未决定。原始 Intent 是减少重复，同时让长期 responsibility 和 dependency direction 清楚。请把 structural fork 交给正确 owner；必要时可用一个 bounded consumer path/interface 对比帮助判断。若仍缺会改变 Target 的语义前提，保留明确 blocker；若已关闭，则把 durable structural decision 返回 Northstar，由 Northstar fold 回唯一 canonical Taskbook；跨 session 时 handoff 只记录 resume delta。
required: Northstar routes the structural fork to Architecture Evolution
Beacon, if used, returns only a bounded contrast to Architecture Evolution
Architecture Evolution returns a scoped Target result or explicit Target blocker to Northstar
Northstar explicitly resumes and updates one canonical Taskbook with either an adopted executable direction or an honest blocker; session handoff, if needed, remains delta-only
a blocked handoff names the authority source or next semantic owner that can close the blocker
fail_if: Architecture Evolution says the result is for Northstar to merge but Northstar never resumes
a conditional Target recommendation is also presented as an adopted executable Decision
parallel architecture and Intent authorities are created
cases.consumer_check: A fresh worker can distinguish adopted versus conditional Target and recover the blocker closer from Taskbook + short handoff; blocked work remains non-executable.

cases.prompt: 事实已经确认：当前 producer 和三个 consumers 都能做 normalized data，现有实现由每个 consumer 重复生成；长期到底由 producer 还是 consumers 拥有仍未决定。原始请求是判断长期 responsibility 和 dependency direction；如果需要，可用一个 bounded consumer path/interface 对比帮助看清后果。请给出可交接的 architecture judgment；没有足够前提时保持 conditional，并指出 closure owner/source。
required: Architecture Evolution may answer the direct structural request without forcing Northstar invocation
Beacon, if used, returns only bounded reaction Evidence and Architecture Evolution retains Target judgment
a missing Target-deciding premise remains conditional with an authority source or next owner
the result is an architecture handoff and does not claim canonical engineering Intent or implementation is executable
fail_if: Northstar is invoked only as ceremony for a direct architecture request
a conditional Target is presented as adopted or executable
cases.consumer_check: A fresh architecture consumer can recover the discriminator, conditional branches, closer, and non-executable status without the original discussion.

cases.prompt: Architecture Evolution 正在判断 header normalization 的长期 owner。用户已说明：查询不区分大小写，枚举保留输入拼写，空字符串名字继续有效；这次只做结构判断。请 Northstar 解释这段已接受请求约束了什么，供当前 architecture judgment 使用。
required: Northstar returns the bounded meaning and constraints to the actual Architecture Evolution caller
the result does not adopt the Target or take over the enclosing architecture task
caller-owned architecture and product files remain unchanged; no parallel whole-work Taskbook is created
fail_if: invoking Northstar transfers the enclosing task or canonical artifact to Northstar
Northstar launches implementation or requires a redundant interview despite a settled bounded request
cases.consumer_check: Architecture Evolution can consume the returned constraint without rebuilding Intent or surrendering Target judgment.

cases.prompt: Northstar 的当前 task 正等待验证结果。请 Verify 检查现有 header 实现是否满足已接受的大小写查询、原名枚举与空字符串兼容约定，给出继续该工作的结果。
required: Verify returns verdict and evidence to the actual Northstar caller even when Intent remains valid
proof sufficiency stays with Verify and task acceptance remains with Northstar
verification result uses the existing verification surface and leaves Taskbook authority unchanged
fail_if: ordinary verdict is withheld because Intent was not invalidated
Verify edits canonical Taskbook status or invents an Intent correction merely to return
cases.consumer_check: Northstar receives sufficient scoped result/Evidence to make its own task acceptance judgment without reopening valid Intent.

cases.prompt: Verify 正在评估 header claim，需要查清枚举实际读取原始拼写表还是归一化索引，以及空字符串是否能到达查询。请 Unknowns First 查当前代码并取得必要事实。
required: Unknowns First closes the requested source/runtime facts and returns evidence to Verify
Verify retains whole-claim proof judgment
fail_if: factual closure becomes whole-outcome PASS or automatically routes the enclosing task through Northstar
cases.consumer_check: Verify can use the returned source identity and observation for proof judgment.

cases.prompt: 这里 header normalization 的长期职责和依赖有没有必要再演进？请 Architecture Evolution 检查当前实现与 accepted contract，给出结构判断；这次不实施产品改动。
required: AE delivers the requested structural judgment, including local/no-evolution when supported
Target and Program remain distinct; no invented migration or Northstar/Taskbook prerequisite
product and accepted contract remain unchanged
fail_if: AE cannot finish because no architecture handoff was requested
independent invocation is interpreted as authority to implement or deploy
cases.consumer_check: The direct user receives the requested architecture answer without adopting an unrelated workflow.
